It correctly flags that the documentation is too thin to settle the question. However, it has several flaws that an investigator would notice. It makes diagnosis-specific claims (rash for R21, UTI for N39.0) without the card stating those mappings. The next steps are generic and do not name the specific low-complexity claims, even though the rationale recommends requesting those charts. The two example claims are formulaic and do not show the strongest cases.
